# Ollama Management

This layer handles scripts for managing Ollama releases and models, including hashing archive files and computing checksums.

## Overview

The Ollama Management layer is responsible for ensuring the integrity and authenticity of Ollama releases and models. It includes scripts that hash archive files and compute checksums to verify their contents.

## Responsibilities

- Hashing archive files
- Computing checksums for Ollama releases and models

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`scripts/archive-hashes.js`](../scripts/archive-hashes.js) | Lists files in an Ollama release archive. | `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, `field` |
| [`scripts/update-models.js`](../scripts/update-models.js) | Records model pinning digests. | `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, `main` |
| [`scripts/update-ollama.sh`](../scripts/update-ollama.sh) | Computes release and model digests. |  |

## How it works

### scripts/archive-hashes.js

This script lists files in an Ollama release archive and computes their hashes.

- **hashArchive**: Function to hash an archive file.
- **hashTar**: Function to hash a tar file.
- **wanted**: Array of files to be hashed.
- **field**: Field name for the hash.

### scripts/update-models.js

This script records model pinning digests.

- **fetchPin**: Function to fetch model pinning information.
- **manifestUrl**: URL of the manifest file.
- **pinFromManifest**: Function to pin models from the manifest.
- **main**: Main function to execute the script.

### scripts/update-ollama.sh

This script computes release and model digests.

- Computes hashes for Ollama releases and models.
- Ensures the integrity of the release and model files.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`.
